source_read: https://www.zizzi.co.uk/menus (+ its 4 menu tabs) and the menu pages of the 127 Great Britain restaurants in its sitemap (full menu + 3 Course, 2 Course Lunch, Bambini and Festive tabs, plus the Two Feast for £50 tab at the 9 restaurants that list it: 635 pages), downloaded 2026-10-10 23:49 UTC to 2026-10-11 00:10 UTC; central /menus SHA-256 bf69cb83ec0192ea7c1db4fbbec08448851d8921e1cde7516cf300cb761393a1. The sitemap lists 132 restaurant menu pages: 3 Dublin and 2 Belfast restaurants (the site gives them their own ROI & Belfast guides) were left out. robots.txt (RFC 9309 matcher): User-agent * Allow / ; Disallow /api/ /studio/ /bookings/share/ /_next/. No other host contacted. The nutrition/allergen PDFs on cdn.sanity.io (robots: Disallow /*.pdf) were not used.
method: Fresh copies of 7 pages were downloaded with curl on 2026-10-11 (Manchester Piccadilly: full menu, 3 Course, 2 Course Lunch, Bambini, Festive; Colchester: full menu and Two Feast for £50) and read offline in headless Chromium with JavaScript off and every network request aborted (innerText of each dish card: name, 'NNN kcal', Vegetarian/Vegan chips), a different method from the script's regex parse of its own cache. 41 published rows picked by rule (lowest and highest calories, then the middle row and the second row of every category, a row from every menu kind) were compared name by name and number by number, plus the vegetarian tag against the page's chips.
not_verifiable: allergens: none published (the chain's allergen source is the 'Allergen Guide (UK)' PDF on a host whose robots.txt disallows it; the per-dish allergen list in the page's script data is not shown on the page and was not used), so nothing was compared. Alcoholic drinks print no calories on the page (105 dishes; the page's script data holds a number it does not show, never used); Gelato & Sorbet (3 scoops) and the 'Lunch menu' placeholder print none either.
notes: Calories-only chain. In the script's own checks every dish's rendered 'NNN kcal' equals the number in the page's script data (all 635 pages), the central page's JSON-LD agrees with its rendered text for all 292 names, and the central page agrees with the 127 restaurants. Full menu: every dish prints identical calories at all 127 restaurants (0 left out). 3 Course, Bambini and Festive menus: 0 left out. 2 Course Lunch Menu: 13 dish names are left out because 9 restaurants print another number (mostly the full-menu one, e.g. Margherita 941) where the other 118 print 899; only Pepperoni Campagna (962) is published from it, labelled with the menu's name. The 9 restaurants that list Two Feast for £50 have no 3 Course dishes; its 20 dishes (14 starters, 6 mains) are published because they match at all 9 restaurants, labelled 'Dish (Two Feast for £50)' where the number differs from the full menu.
